native_title: ファンフィクション脱出白書
description:
On July 2016, the very day the popular idol group Boy White Paper met a tragic accident, die-hard fan Hanna suddenly finds herself transported into the fanfiction she wrote four years ago. Now inhabiting the role of a cross-dressing female member, she has one mission: to bring together Haejun and Juwon, the central couple of her story. But can she really follow the script to its ending and safely escape her own fanfic… or will her presence rewrite everything?
